_doc: The desert's woods (bead bzc.88, docs/art/classes/trees.md): palm and cactus groves on sand. generate-image-v2 at 48 x 48 like set trees (one call returns many candidates of a mixed subject); the best distinct ones are accepted and cropped to their opaque box plus 1 px. Never scaled, never mirrored. Layers: style, light, class-tree, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: one small desert oasis palm tree, each image a different one of these: a date palm with a round crown of arching fronds and a cluster of orange dates, a short squat fan palm with a bushy crown, a young palm with a slightly leaning ringed trunk, a double palm with two crowns from one base. Fronds deep olive green #4f7a3a, shadow #2f5028, light #7fa356 on the left side; a ringed tan trunk #a27a4a with shadow #6e4e2c. A full crown about two thirds of the image wide, nearly the full image tall.
recipes.negative: coconut, beach, sand patch, ground, grass, flowers, pot

recipes.subject: Subject: one desert cactus, each image a different one of these: a tall saguaro with two raised arms, a chunky saguaro with one arm, a big clump of round prickly pear pads with a few pink fruits, a cluster of three ribbed column cacti of different heights, a fat round barrel cactus with a yellow flower on top. Cactus green #5f8a4a, shadow #3a5a34, light #8fb36a on the left side, pale spines. Chunky and solid, about half of the image wide and most of the image tall.
recipes.negative: pot, flower pot, sand patch, ground, face, eyes, skull
